results.content: # Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Manga Takes One-Month Break, Next Chapter Delayed Until September. The Boruto manga is taking a one-month break. The series' official X account announced that Boruto: Two Blue Vortex will skip the next issue of Shueisha's V Jump magazine, which is scheduled for release on August 21 in Japan. The manga will instead return in the following issue on September 18. Boruto: Two Blue Vortex is the second part of the Boruto manga and serves as a direct continuation of Boruto: Naruto Next Generations.
